Select molecules reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id CHEMBL4011581. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name (pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
